crossRefs.note: Don’t be wise in your own eyes. Fear Yahweh, and depart from evil.
It will be health to your body, and nourishment to your bones.
Don’t be afraid of sudden fear, neither of the desolation of the wicked, when it comes;
for Yahweh will be your confidence, and will keep your foot from being taken.
The fear of Yahweh leads to life, then contentment; he rests and will not be touched by trouble.
Unless the God of my father, the God of Abraham, and the fear of Isaac, had been with me, surely now you would have…
Yahweh’s angel encamps around those who fear him, and delivers them.
Praise Yah! Blessed is the man who fears Yahweh, who delights greatly in his commandments.
For he will never be shaken. The righteous will be remembered forever.
He will bless those who fear Yahweh, both small and great.
May Yahweh increase you more and more, you and your children.

So the assemblies throughout all Judea, Galilee, and Samaria had peace, and were built up. They were multiplied…
Yahweh’s name is a strong tower: the righteous run to him, and are safe.

Yahweh said, “Most certainly I will strengthen you for good. Most certainly I will cause the enemy to make supplication…
I will give them one heart and one way, that they may fear me forever, for their good, and the good of their children…

translations.web: In the fear of Yahweh is a secure fortress, and he will be a refuge for his children.
translations.bsb: He who fears the LORD is secure in confidence, and his children shall have a place of refuge.
translations.kjv: In the fear of the LORD is strong confidence: and his children shall have a place of refuge.
translations.asv: In the fear of Jehovah is strong confidence; And his children shall have a place of refuge.
